verdict.rationale: Antigravity's own docs have a dedicated MCP page saying MCP lets the agent fetch context and execute actions through connected local tools, databases and remote APIs. The CLI exposes MCP configuration via slash commands, plugins can bundle MCP servers, and the Agent SDK can layer MCP servers over built-in tools. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how servers are configured (config format, transports), independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP server use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: MCP lets Antigravity fetch structured context directly or execute safe actions on your behalf when needed.
lets AI agents and editors securely connect to local developer tools, databases, file parsers, and external remote APIs
Access plugins, MCP, skills, and hooks configurations instantly via slash commands
Plugins are namespaced bundles that allow you to extend Antigravity’s capabilities by grouping skills, rules, MCP servers, and hooks into a single package.
Layer custom Python callables, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and reusable agent skills over our built-in filesystem and terminal tools under a single pipeline.
